# QR Generator

`qrcode-generator.mjs` is the unmodified ESM distribution of
`qrcode-generator` 2.0.4 from npm, licensed under MIT.

Source: https://github.com/kazuhikoarase/qrcode-generator

The local copy allows the HR module to generate QR codes offline.
To update it, install the matching npm version and copy
`node_modules/qrcode-generator/dist/qrcode.mjs` here, preserving its license.
